loops.name: core-upgrade
loops.description: The only way the immutable control-plane core changes — ADR, tests, canary, Owner approval, version bump, Ledger.

loops.name: decision
loops.description: The load-bearing-decision loop — identify type → convene the required hats per decision-rights → CRO verifies → CoS ratifies → record → Owner-gate where required. Makes "the right people in the room" mechanical.

loops.name: heal
loops.description: Self-heal loop — recurse on a failing check until it passes or the budget is exhausted, then escalate to the Owner.

loops.name: level-set
loops.description: The recurring paydown-and-reflection loop — the C-suite (or a scoped subset) each assesses its domain read-only, the CoS synthesizes a ranked plan spanning tech debt AND organizational lessons, and the Owner picks the track. Cadence-triggered; feeds the ticket-cycle.

loops.name: new-app
loops.description: The loop that manufactures a new app on the Golden Path, one repo, contract-conformant, with a green test gate.

loops.name: request-intake
loops.description: The Owner's request-intake loop — submit → triage → decide → respond. Feeds ticket-cycle.

loops.name: staffing-review
loops.description: The recurring staffing-health loop — the Chief of Staff audits the employee roster, the template catalog, and the model presets on a cadence, retiring stale employees and truing up presets against the resource budget, then tickets any change through the gated path. The "ongoing, automated" staffing project.

loops.name: ticket-cycle
loops.description: The operating loop — a retro-driven, governed, terminating ticket flow. How Scope Creep works turn to turn.
